units.italian: Recupera i regali di nozze rubati

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|description|17|0
units.english: Look for a stolen shipment of wedding gifts meant for House Myurej on <destination>.
units.italian: Cerca una partita di regali di nozze rubata, destinata a Casa Myurej, su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|While walking in the spaceport here, you are pulled aside by a pair of House Myurej military officers. "Come with us," one says, "thou shalt not be harmed, but thou hast a private meeting waiting thou needest attend."|30|0
units.english: While walking in the spaceport here, you are pulled aside by a pair of House Myurej military officers. "Come with us," one says, "thou shalt not be harmed, but thou hast a private meeting waiting thou needest attend."
units.italian: Mentre cammini per lo spazioporto, due ufficiali militari di Casa Myurej ti prendono da parte. "Vieni con noi," dice uno, "non ti sarà fatto alcun male, ma ti attende un incontro privato a cui devi presenziare."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	(Go with them.)|32|0
units.english: (Go with them.)
units.italian: (Vai con loro.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	(Run away.)|33|0
units.english: (Run away.)
units.italian: (Scappa via.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	The two take you to a dense nest of shops and hotels on a hill overlooking one of the massive spaceport's loading docks; it lies what must be more than a hundred meters below. A web of canals interleaves the regularly-misted streets, and looking inside, you can see groups of Successors swimming in various directions, occasionally emerging onto the terrestrial paths and shaking off water from the hydrophobic fabrics of their clothing. You are led to a small, comfortable-looking hotel overlooking one of these canals, and deposited in a medium-sized oblong room, divided roughly in half by an oily-colored fabric screen. The guards motion for you to sit on a chair on one side of it, and you comply.|35|0
units.english: The two take you to a dense nest of shops and hotels on a hill overlooking one of the massive spaceport's loading docks; it lies what must be more than a hundred meters below. A web of canals interleaves the regularly-misted streets, and looking inside, you can see groups of Successors swimming in various directions, occasionally emerging onto the terrestrial paths and shaking off water from the hydrophobic fabrics of their clothing. You are led to a small, comfortable-looking hotel overlooking one of these canals, and deposited in a medium-sized oblong room, divided roughly in half by an oily-colored fabric screen. The guards motion for you to sit on a chair on one side of it, and you comply.
units.italian: I due ti conducono in un fitto intrico di botteghe e alberghi su una collina che sovrasta una delle enormi banchine di carico dello spazioporto; la banchina sta certo a più di cento metri sotto. Una rete di canali si intreccia alle strade, perennemente avvolte nella foschia, e guardando dentro vedi gruppi di Successori che nuotano in varie direzioni, ogni tanto emergendo sui sentieri asciutti e scrollandosi di dosso l'acqua dai tessuti idrofobici dei loro abiti. Ti fanno entrare in un piccolo albergo dall'aria accogliente che dà su uno di questi canali, e ti lasciano in una stanza oblunga di medie dimensioni, divisa all'incirca a metà da un paravento di tessuto color olio. Le guardie ti fanno cenno di sederti su una sedia da un lato, e tu obbedisci.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	From the other side of the screen comes a slow voice that your translation device duly rearranges into your language: "Captain <first> <last>, I believe?"|36|0
units.english: From the other side of the screen comes a slow voice that your translation device duly rearranges into your language: "Captain <first> <last>, I believe?"
units.italian: Dall'altro lato del paravento arriva una voce lenta, che il tuo dispositivo di traduzione riordina puntualmente nella tua lingua: "Capitano <first> <last>, credo?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	"Yes?"|38|0
units.english: "Yes?"
units.italian: "Sì?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	"Who's asking?"|39|0
units.english: "Who's asking?"
units.italian: "E tu chi sei?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	"House Myurej longs to exercise thy services. Something belonging to us was stolen. Thou shalt be compensated for its safe return. Doth this interest thee?" The screen shimmers in one long, glittery wave. Behind you, one of the guards shuffles.|40|0
units.english: "House Myurej longs to exercise thy services. Something belonging to us was stolen. Thou shalt be compensated for its safe return. Doth this interest thee?" The screen shimmers in one long, glittery wave. Behind you, one of the guards shuffles.
units.italian: "Casa Myurej desidera avvalersi dei tuoi servigi. Ci è stato rubato qualcosa. Sarai ricompensato per il suo sicuro recupero. Ti interessa?" Il paravento ondeggia in una lunga onda scintillante. Dietro di te, una delle guardie si muove irrequieta.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	"You're going to have to give me more than that," you say.|41|0
units.english: "You're going to have to give me more than that," you say.
units.italian: "Dovrai dirmi qualcosa di più," dici.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	The wave rebounds off the far wall and retraces its way back down the screen. "Hast thou before entered into the bonds of matrimony?" the voice says. Before you can respond, it continues. "'Tis customary, when one doth, for the celebrants to render some minor gifts upon the duly unified, a commemoration of the families' intertwining evermore. To steal such trinkets would be a base and wretched act - a child-race as yours should still conceive of that." The wave continues to echo, back and forth. "A certain knave'f the so-called People's Houses thought it wise to thus insult this happy House, on the eve of another day of joy, no doubt thinking with a dead mind they lay beyond our reach. Bring back our gifts, and we shall pay thee..." The voice pauses for a while, as if away in thought. "And perhaps thou wilt have earned a favor, though alien thou mightst be."|42|0
units.english: The wave rebounds off the far wall and retraces its way back down the screen. "Hast thou before entered into the bonds of matrimony?" the voice says. Before you can respond, it continues. "'Tis customary, when one doth, for the celebrants to render some minor gifts upon the duly unified, a commemoration of the families' intertwining evermore. To steal such trinkets would be a base and wretched act - a child-race as yours should still conceive of that." The wave continues to echo, back and forth. "A certain knave'f the so-called People's Houses thought it wise to thus insult this happy House, on the eve of another day of joy, no doubt thinking with a dead mind they lay beyond our reach. Bring back our gifts, and we shall pay thee..." The voice pauses for a while, as if away in thought. "And perhaps thou wilt have earned a favor, though alien thou mightst be."
units.italian: L'onda rimbalza sulla parete in fondo e ridiscende lungo il paravento. "Sei mai entrato nei vincoli del matrimonio?" dice la voce. Prima che tu possa rispondere, prosegue. "È usanza, quando ciò avviene, che i celebranti offrano alcuni doni minori ai novelli uniti, a commemorazione dell'intreccio delle famiglie, per sempre. Rubare simili gingilli sarebbe un atto vile e meschino: una razza bambina come la vostra dovrebbe pur concepirlo." L'onda continua a riecheggiare, avanti e indietro. "Un certo farabutto delle cosiddette Casate del Popolo ha pensato bene di insultare così questa felice Casa, alla vigilia di un altro giorno di gioia, senza dubbio credendo, con mente morta, di essere fuori dalla nostra portata. Riportaci i nostri doni e ti pagheremo..." La voce tace per un po', come assorto nei pensieri. "E forse ti sarai guadagnato un favore, benché tu sia uno straniero."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	"Why ask me?"|44|0
units.english: "Why ask me?"
units.italian: "Perché proprio me?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	"How much are you going to pay me?"|45|0
units.english: "How much are you going to pay me?"
units.italian: "Quanto mi pagherai?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	"All right, I'll do it."|47|0
units.english: "All right, I'll do it."
units.italian: "Va bene, lo faccio."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	"Sorry, but I don't want any part of this."|49|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I don't want any part of this."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non voglio entrarci."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	"Riijaaora of House Sioeora speaks well of thee, dost thou know? Thy reliability, thy strength of will. They say thou'rt capable of this task, and we know thou'rt uniquely suited to it. Wilt thou accept?"|53|0
units.english: "Riijaaora of House Sioeora speaks well of thee, dost thou know? Thy reliability, thy strength of will. They say thou'rt capable of this task, and we know thou'rt uniquely suited to it. Wilt thou accept?"
units.italian: "Riijaaora di Casa Sioeora parla bene di te, lo sai? Della tua affidabilità, della tua forza di volontà. Dicono che sei capace di questo compito, e sappiamo che sei particolarmente adatto. Accetti?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	"After thou fail'dst Sioeora as thou did'st, thinks thee? Nonetheless, thou'rt more suitable to our needs than any other. Shouldst thou decline, we shall simply move on to the next. So, wilt thou accept?"|56|0
units.english: "After thou fail'dst Sioeora as thou did'st, thinks thee? Nonetheless, thou'rt more suitable to our needs than any other. Shouldst thou decline, we shall simply move on to the next. So, wilt thou accept?"
units.italian: "Dopo che hai fallito con Sioeora come hai fatto, credi? Eppure sei più adatto alle nostre esigenze di chiunque altro. Se rifiutassi, passeremmo semplicemente al prossimo. Dunque, accetti?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	The voice hums briefly. "Four hundred thousand credits," they say, "not to be negotiated. Dost thou accept?"|59|0
units.english: The voice hums briefly. "Four hundred thousand credits," they say, "not to be negotiated. Dost thou accept?"
units.italian: La voce emette un breve ronzio. "Quattrocentomila crediti," dice, "non trattabili. Accetti?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|label|60|0
units.english: follow up
units.italian: follow up

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	"All right, I'll do it."|62|0
units.english: "All right, I'll do it."
units.italian: "Va bene, lo faccio."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	"Sorry, but I don't want any part of this."|63|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I don't want any part of this."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non voglio entrarci."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|log|67|0
units.english: People
units.italian: People

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|log|68|0
units.english: Accepted an offer by House Myurej to track down and recover a shipment of wedding gifts stolen by a member of the People's Houses.
units.italian: Hai accettato l'offerta di Casa Myurej di rintracciare e recuperare una partita di regali di nozze rubata da un membro delle Casate del Popolo.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	The shimmering wave seems like it's losing energy now, growing slower and fainter with each cycle back and forth. "Excellent," says the voice. "The quarry thou shouldst seek on Kasii-Tuur-Saqru is by name Riiria, a well-known thief and useful fool. Shouldst thy own powers of searching fail thee, we've a friend of the House there too, a sharp-eyed merchant captain eager to get involved in things they think to be rewarding. Our agents here shall see that thou receiv'st the details at thy ship." You hear the rustling of fabric and the faint wet slithering of a Successor moving. The guards behind you relax and, as you turn to look at them, they gesture towards the door. Before you leave, the voice speaks one last time. "Do not fail us, captain."|69|0
units.english: The shimmering wave seems like it's losing energy now, growing slower and fainter with each cycle back and forth. "Excellent," says the voice. "The quarry thou shouldst seek on Kasii-Tuur-Saqru is by name Riiria, a well-known thief and useful fool. Shouldst thy own powers of searching fail thee, we've a friend of the House there too, a sharp-eyed merchant captain eager to get involved in things they think to be rewarding. Our agents here shall see that thou receiv'st the details at thy ship." You hear the rustling of fabric and the faint wet slithering of a Successor moving. The guards behind you relax and, as you turn to look at them, they gesture towards the door. Before you leave, the voice speaks one last time. "Do not fail us, captain."
units.italian: L'onda scintillante sembra perdere energia, facendosi più lenta e fievole a ogni ciclo avanti e indietro. "Eccellente," dice la voce. "La preda che devi cercare su Kasii-Tuur-Saqru si chiama Riiria, ladra ben nota e utile sciocca. Se i tuoi mezzi di ricerca ti dovessero mancare, abbiamo là anche un amico della Casa, un capitano mercante dall'occhio acuto, impaziente di immischiarsi in ciò che ritiene remunerativo. I nostri agenti qui provvederanno a farti avere i dettagli alla tua nave." Senti il fruscio del tessuto e un debole strisciare umido: un Successore che si muove. Le guardie dietro di te si rilassano e, quando ti volti a guardarle, accennano alla porta. Prima che tu esca, la voce parla un'ultima volta. "Non deluderci, capitano."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	You are escorted back to the edge of the residential area by the guards, who leave you to find your own way back to your ship. As the ground crew finish up their refueling and maintenance of the <ship>, one of them hands you a data-sphere containing information about Riiria and House Myurej's contact on Kasii-Tuur-Saqru.|70|0
units.english: You are escorted back to the edge of the residential area by the guards, who leave you to find your own way back to your ship. As the ground crew finish up their refueling and maintenance of the <ship>, one of them hands you a data-sphere containing information about Riiria and House Myurej's contact on Kasii-Tuur-Saqru.
units.italian: Le guardie ti riaccompagnano fino al margine della zona residenziale e ti lasciano andare da solo verso la tua nave. Mentre la squadra di terra finisce di rifornirla e di fare manutenzione alla <ship>, uno di loro ti porge una sfera di dati con le informazioni su Riiria e sul contatto di Casa Myurej su Kasii-Tuur-Saqru.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	Kicking a stone to the side to distract the pair, you dash into the crowd before they can stop you. You're probably lucky that they didn't shoot you for that.|74|0
units.english: Kicking a stone to the side to distract the pair, you dash into the crowd before they can stop you. You're probably lucky that they didn't shoot you for that.
units.italian: Calciando un sasso di lato per distrarre la coppia, ti tuffi tra la folla prima che possano fermarti. Sei probabilmente fortunato che non ti abbiano sparato per questo.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	The voice gives a long hum but says no more. After a couple moments you hesitantly get up and, when the guards make no motion to prevent you, you leave.|77|0
units.english: The voice gives a long hum but says no more. After a couple moments you hesitantly get up and, when the guards make no motion to prevent you, you leave.
units.italian: La voce emette un lungo ronzio ma non dice altro. Dopo un paio di momenti ti alzi esitante e, visto che le guardie non fanno alcun gesto per trattenerti, te ne vai.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|You guide the <ship> into the crowded spaceport of <planet>, narrowly avoiding a collision with one of a wing of armored-up Kvelqden rocketing out of the docking section.|81|0
units.english: You guide the <ship> into the crowded spaceport of <planet>, narrowly avoiding a collision with one of a wing of armored-up Kvelqden rocketing out of the docking section.
units.italian: Guidi la <ship> nello spazioporto affollato di <planet>, evitando per un soffio la collisione con uno stormo di Kvelqden corazzati che schizza fuori dalla sezione di attracco.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	(Seek out Myurej's contact.)|83|0
units.english: (Seek out Myurej's contact.)
units.italian: (Cerca il contatto di Casa Myurej.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	(Look around for yourself first.)|85|0
units.english: (Look around for yourself first.)
units.italian: (Prima guardati un po' intorno.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	Exploring the visitor-accessible part of the station is an unusual experience - there's a striking contrast between the presence of all the advanced technologies of the Successors and the fact that so many of them are in such disrepair. You've seen Successor constructions that are hundreds or even thousands of years old in better condition than those here. You try to talk to a few of the Successors around here about Riiria, but they all quickly dismiss you, most without even saying a word.|88|0
units.english: Exploring the visitor-accessible part of the station is an unusual experience - there's a striking contrast between the presence of all the advanced technologies of the Successors and the fact that so many of them are in such disrepair. You've seen Successor constructions that are hundreds or even thousands of years old in better condition than those here. You try to talk to a few of the Successors around here about Riiria, but they all quickly dismiss you, most without even saying a word.
units.italian: Esplorare la parte della stazione accessibile ai visitatori è un'esperienza insolita: c'è uno stridente contrasto tra la presenza di tutte le tecnologie avanzate dei Successori e il fatto che tante di esse siano in così cattivo stato. Hai visto costruzioni dei Successori vecchie di centinaia o persino migliaia di anni in condizioni migliori di queste. Provi a parlare con alcuni dei Successori dei dintorni di Riiria, ma tutti ti liquidano in fretta, la maggior parte senza dire nemmeno una parola.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	Eventually you find your way to a shop of some sort - what looks like a gutted Myaede bolted to the station's structure and filled with displays of fabric and ship parts, all attended to by about a dozen small robots running on tracks on the ceiling. They follow you around like a school of fish; a couple of them have some ominous-looking apertures on their front. Suddenly, you hear the edited sound of Successor speech behind one of the displays of what looks like engine injectors. A small screen is projecting an image of a speaking Successor:|89|0
units.english: Eventually you find your way to a shop of some sort - what looks like a gutted Myaede bolted to the station's structure and filled with displays of fabric and ship parts, all attended to by about a dozen small robots running on tracks on the ceiling. They follow you around like a school of fish; a couple of them have some ominous-looking apertures on their front. Suddenly, you hear the edited sound of Successor speech behind one of the displays of what looks like engine injectors. A small screen is projecting an image of a speaking Successor:
units.italian: Alla fine arrivi a una specie di bottega: quello che sembra un Myaede sventrato, imbullonato alla struttura della stazione e riempito di espositori di tessuti e pezzi di nave, il tutto sorvegliato da una dozzina circa di piccoli robot che corrono su rotaie fissate al soffitto. Ti seguono come un banco di pesci; un paio di loro hanno sul davanti alcune aperture dall'aria minacciosa. All'improvviso senti, dietro uno degli espositori di quelli che sembrano iniettori per motori, il suono rielaborato del parlare dei Successori. Un piccolo schermo proietta l'immagine di un Successore che parla:

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	"...violence against Kaatrij is about us, too, siblings! The only one of the Houses who bothers t'give us the cant of an arm! For long the Old've wanted us gone entire, and believe me, this'll be the start'f it! Well, 'f they come for us, Riiria will make them bleed like I always do!" The transmission cuts out there, and with no further leads on Riiria's location, you decide to track down Myurej's contact.|90|0
units.english: "...violence against Kaatrij is about us, too, siblings! The only one of the Houses who bothers t'give us the cant of an arm! For long the Old've wanted us gone entire, and believe me, this'll be the start'f it! Well, 'f they come for us, Riiria will make them bleed like I always do!" The transmission cuts out there, and with no further leads on Riiria's location, you decide to track down Myurej's contact.
units.italian: "...la violenza contro Kaatrij riguarda anche noi, fratelli! L'unica delle Casate che si degni di darci il cenno di un braccio! Da tempo i Vecchi ci vogliono spariti del tutto, e credetemi, questo sarà solo l'inizio! Beh, se vengono a prendere noi, Riiria li farà sanguinare come faccio sempre io!" La trasmissione si interrompe lì e, senza altre piste sulla posizione di Riiria, decidi di rintracciare il contatto di Casa Myurej.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	The Myurej merchant captain turns out to be almost a kilometer down the station's perimeter among some loading docks that station control apparently doesn't send unfamiliar ships to. They're directing several members of their crew to offload some crates - one of them has been dropped and has spilled out a collection of unfamiliar metal baubles.|92|0
units.english: The Myurej merchant captain turns out to be almost a kilometer down the station's perimeter among some loading docks that station control apparently doesn't send unfamiliar ships to. They're directing several members of their crew to offload some crates - one of them has been dropped and has spilled out a collection of unfamiliar metal baubles.
units.italian: Il capitano mercante di Casa Myurej si rivela essere quasi un chilometro più in là lungo il perimetro della stazione, tra alcune banchine di carico dove il controllo della stazione evidentemente non manda navi sconosciute. Sta dirigendo diversi membri del suo equipaggio nello scarico di alcune casse: una è caduta e ha rovesciato una collezione di ninnoli di metallo sconosciuti.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	"I'm Captain <first> <last>. Myurej sent me."|94|0
units.english: "I'm Captain <first> <last>. Myurej sent me."
units.italian: "Sono il capitano <first> <last>. Mi manda Myurej."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	"What are those things?"|96|0
units.english: "What are those things?"
units.italian: "Che cos'è tutta quella roba?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	"What cares thou? Thou'rt in the way, go off." They wave you away.|97|0
units.english: "What cares thou? Thou'rt in the way, go off." They wave you away.
units.italian: "Che te ne importa? Sei tra i piedi, vattene." Ti allontanano con un gesto.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	"Fine," you say. "Captain <first> <last>. Myurej sent me."|98|0
units.english: "Fine," you say. "Captain <first> <last>. Myurej sent me."
units.italian: "Va bene," dici. "Capitano <first> <last>. Mi manda Myurej."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	A wave of red and black bristles over their skin. "Of course," they say. "I should've guessed. Come to send me on some wild quest for some bit of finery, is it? Some golden child lost their favorite jewel?"|100|0
units.english: A wave of red and black bristles over their skin. "Of course," they say. "I should've guessed. Come to send me on some wild quest for some bit of finery, is it? Some golden child lost their favorite jewel?"
units.italian: Un'onda di rosso e nero gli irriga la pelle. "Ma certo," dicono. "Avrei dovuto immaginarlo. Vieni a mandarmi in qualche folle impresa per un gingillo, eh? Qualche rampollo viziato che ha perso il suo gioiello preferito?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	"Well, sort of," you say. "All I need from you is the location of Riiria. They stole something from Myurej that the House wants back."|101|0
units.english: "Well, sort of," you say. "All I need from you is the location of Riiria. They stole something from Myurej that the House wants back."
units.italian: "Beh, più o meno," dici. "Tutto quello che mi serve da te è il luogo in cui si trova Riiria. Hanno rubato qualcosa a Myurej che la Casa rivuole indietro."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	"Predictable," they say. "Some blow to pride and they get a knave like thee to crawl in the mud."|102|0
units.english: "Predictable," they say. "Some blow to pride and they get a knave like thee to crawl in the mud."
units.italian: "Prevedibile," dicono. "Un colpo all'orgoglio e si prendono un farabutto come te che striscia nel fango."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	"Just get to the point."|104|0
units.english: "Just get to the point."
units.italian: "Vieni al dunque."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	"Why are you so angry?"|106|0
units.english: "Why are you so angry?"
units.italian: "Perché sei così arrabbiato?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 1|	"No, not angry," they say. "Tired. They pay me to change my routes, I accept. They pay me to talk to the fools they send to me, I accept. They pay me to transport unknowables, and I lap it up. Thought the family connection would make things easier, but what dost thou do when that 'family's just after thee for thine use to them?" They let the colors of anger subside and gently rub three of their arms together.|107|0
units.english: "No, not angry," they say. "Tired. They pay me to change my routes, I accept. They pay me to talk to the fools they send to me, I accept. They pay me to transport unknowables, and I lap it up. Thought the family connection would make things easier, but what dost thou do when that 'family's just after thee for thine use to them?" They let the colors of anger subside and gently rub three of their arms together.
units.italian: "No, non arrabbiato," dicono. "Stanco. Mi pagano per cambiare le mie rotte, e accetto. Mi pagano per parlare con gli sciocchi che mi mandano, e accetto. Mi pagano per trasportare cose incomprensibili, e io ne approfitto. Pensavo che il legame di famiglia avrebbe reso le cose più facili, ma che fai quando quella 'famiglia' ti sta dietro solo per ciò che puoi darle?" Lasciano che i colori della collera si placino e si strofinano piano tre delle loro braccia l'una contro l'altra.

units.english: "Fine. I hear that Riiria's hiding out among the hollow stations 'round our neighbor stars. They're good to hide if thou hast stolen something, brilliant hard to scan a sleeping ship among the broken spires. The northerly one... Vade-Osolaa-Kaska, I recall, 'tis a favorite spot for Riiria and their type. Were I thee, I'd crawl there first." The Successor pauses to look at one of the boxes being unloaded and makes an exasperated noise. "Not that being thee is aught I would prefer, mind."
units.italian: "Va bene. Ho sentito che Riiria si nasconde tra le stazioni cave attorno alle stelle vicine. Sono un buon nascondiglio se hai rubato qualcosa: è maledettamente difficile scansionare una nave dormiente tra le guglie spezzate. Quella più a nord... Vade-Osolaa-Kaska, mi pare, è un posto preferito da Riiria e dai suoi simili. Se fossi in te, striscerei là per primo." Il Successore si ferma a guardare una delle casse che vengono scaricate e emette un verso esasperato. "Non che essere te sia qualcosa che preferirei, sia chiaro."

units.english: Color once again bristles over their skin, but only for a moment. "Now go 'fore the two of us are seen together," they say, and wave you away. You find your way back to your own ship and mark the nearby uninhabited station on your map.
units.italian: Il colore torna a irrigare la loro pelle, ma solo per un momento. "Ora vai, prima che ci vedano insieme," dicono, e ti allontanano con un gesto. Trovi la strada per tornare alla tua nave e segni sulla mappa la stazione disabitata più vicina.
